fieldValues.title: RFC-034 is spec-accepted and wholly unimplemented in srs-rust
fieldValues.summary: childContainerIds appears nowhere in the srs-rust tree. The accepted nesting mechanism, the direct-versus-effective membership distinction and the retirement of the contains traversal in member_ids all have no implementation, so sectionContainerId remains the only scope marker navigation can use. Filed as srs-rust#970 and pooled.
evidence: A search for childContainerIds across srs-rust returns nothing
container_service::member_ids still traverses contains, which RFC-034 Change C retires
The change touches find --container, container resolve-view, the MCP container resource, containers_for_instance and roughly ten tests
fieldValues.body: The acceptance pull request and the implementation are in different repositories with no gate between them, so a normative change lands as accepted with nothing red anywhere. The gap is visible only to whoever next tries to build on the accepted rule. srs-rust#970.
